question_text: What war did the Americans fight to win independence from Britain?

why_it_matters.text: The American Revolution made the United States a country. Thirteen colonies — small and divided — defeated the most powerful empire on Earth and created a new kind of government, based on the idea that ordinary people could govern themselves. Every freedom Americans have today traces back to this war.

fun_fact.text: The Revolutionary War lasted 8 years (1775-1783). It wasn't just America vs. Britain — it was also a civil war. About 20-30% of colonists stayed loyal to the king and fought against the patriots. After the war, around 60,000 Loyalists fled the U.S. for Canada and other places. Independence split families and neighbors.
